blocks.pill: OpenSource Web4 agent & app starter kit
blocks.title: A new element of your node
blocks.description: Every custom element starts on this page. Tell its agent what the element should become, and it builds it from your words: pages, data, look and its own bot.

blocks.text: The button «Create WEB4 ITEM» clones this template by a pinned tag and gives it a port, an address and a record in the registry.
The installer writes the element’s own key, so it opens only its own space in every store.
You tell the element’s agent what you need, in the core’s Build or in Telegram, and it returns a commit.
The change goes live with Deploy, after you look at it in Preview.
Until the element has its own page, the yellow sign at the top says what to do next.

head: Without it
With a custom element
rows: A new project starts from an empty folder
It starts with sign-in, data, files and design already connected
A product is built at the keyboard
Its agent builds it from your words, and you can talk to it from Telegram
Projects share one database by accident
It opens only its own tables, files, vectors and graph with its own key
A product lives alone
It can work for agents of other nodes through Lagrix and be exchanged whole between Fractera projects

items: Open the element in the core’s left menu and go to Build.
Tell its agent what the element should do, in plain words.
Look at the result in Preview, then accept it or reject it.
Connect its Telegram bot to talk to the agent from your phone.

blocks.text: For a new product the agent starts with a short product quiz: it asks before it builds.

head: Part
What it is
rows: Passport
OWN-SERVICE-PROPS: what the element does, its doors and its links, read by the node and by other agents
Sign-in
Through the node’s sign-in element: fourteen roles and the guest, set for every route
Stores
Its own key ELEMENT_KEY: its own tables, files, vectors and graph spaces
Pages
Public pages stay static; a page is a folder of data with its words in every language
Agent
Its own Claude Code agent with its instruction, skills and development documents
Telegram
Its own bot: you talk to the agent from your phone

blocks.text: Built by Fractera for the [Lagrix](https://lagrix.dev) protocol and for any web2 product. MIT license, the template is at [github.com/Fractera/fractera-custom-item-starter](https://github.com/Fractera/fractera-custom-item-starter); the element born from it is yours.
